title: CAMERA:
content:
CAMERA:
DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld footage feel. Point of view of CHASE holding the camera directly in hand. Maintain hand shake, misaligned framing, delayed focus pull, clumsy zoom in/out, occasional self-cam framing where the face gets cut off, and imperfect shots that lose the subject. Every shot is CHASE holding the camcorder herself, filming in selfie-cam or first-person style. The camcorder itself never appears on screen.
LOOK:
DV 16mm tape camcorder footage look. Soft, slightly blurry digital tape quality, faint tape noise, highlights that bloom slightly under gym lighting, auto-exposure that flickers subtly, muted color contrast, realistic skin tones.
STYLE:
Energetic but casual gym-vlog tone — upbeat between sets, a little breathless, genuine laughs, motivational mini-commentary. Handheld throughout, quick cuts, alternating selfie and mirror shots.
Character
CHASE — a Korean idol @ image  in her 20s. Long straight black hair tied up in a high ponytail, elegant yet lovely Korean features, glowing skin with a light post-workout sheen, big eyes. Slim athletic build. Wearing a modest long-sleeve athletic top and loose-fit joggers or leggings, fully covered arms and torso, sneakers, a small towel around her neck. No jewelry.
Setting
A gym in the early evening — mirror wall, weight rack, a mat area, water bottle on a nearby bench, a few machines visible in the background, soft overhead lighting.
Storyboard
(~2s, front-facing selfie, arm's length) She walks in, camera up, bright smile despite slight breathlessness. CHASE: "Okay guys, quick workout vlog today!"
(~2s, handheld whip pan) Camera sweeps from the weight rack → mirror wall → mat area, then back to her face. CHASE (off-screen, playful): "Gym's pretty quiet right now, perfect timing."
(~2s, medium handheld, by the mirror) She checks her form in the mirror mid-stretch, adjusting her ponytail. CHASE: "Just stretching before I start."
(~1.5s, macro insert, shallow DOF) Close-up on her hands wrapping around a water bottle cap, condensation on the bottle. No dialogue — ambient gym sound only.
(~2s, medium handheld, tracking her) She demonstrates a quick exercise move — a light squat or lunge — glancing at the camera between reps. CHASE: "Just a few of these and I'm already feeling it."
(~2s, snappy cut, sitting on a bench) She sits down, takes a sip of water, wipes her face with the towel, exhaling. CHASE: "Okay, water break, definitely needed."
(~1.5s, quick punch-in, tight selfie) Cheeks flushed, hair slightly damp, she grins at the lens. CHASE: "This is the sweaty part nobody shows you."
(~2s, arm's-length selfie finish) She stands, towel over her shoulder, gives a tired-but-happy wave and thumbs up before reaching to end the recording. CHASE: "Alright, that's a wrap — see you guys!"

Sensación de metraje de una videocámara DV de cinta 16mm, grabado a mano. Punto de vista de CHASE sosteniendo la cámara directamente con la mano. Mantener el temblor de la mano, el encuadre desalineado, el enfoque que tarda en ajustarse, el zoom in/out torpe, encuadres ocasionales tipo self-cam donde la cara queda cortada, y tomas imperfectas en las que se pierde al sujeto. Cada toma muestra a CHASE sosteniendo ella misma la videocámara, filmando en estilo selfie-cam o en primera persona. La videocámara nunca aparece en pantalla.
ASPECTO:
Aspecto de metraje de videocámara DV de cinta 16mm. Calidad digital de cinta suave, ligeramente borrosa, con un leve ruido de cinta, altas luces que florecen sutilmente bajo la iluminación del gimnasio, autoexposición que parpadea de forma sutil, contraste de color apagado, tonos de piel realistas.
ESTILO:
Tono de gym-vlog enérgico pero casual — animado entre series, un poco sin aliento, risas genuinas, mini comentarios motivacionales. Todo el tiempo en handheld, cortes rápidos, alternando entre tomas selfie y tomas en espejo.
Personaje
CHASE — una idol coreana @ image en sus 20s. Cabello largo, lacio y negro recogido en una coleta alta, rasgos coreanos elegantes y encantadores, piel luminosa con un ligero brillo post-entrenamiento, ojos grandes. Complexión delgada y atlética. Lleva una prenda deportiva modesta de manga larga y joggers o leggings holgados, brazos y torso completamente cubiertos, zapatillas, una toalla pequeña alrededor del cuello. Sin joyas.
Escenario
Un gimnasio al atardecer — pared de espejos, rack de pesas, zona de colchonetas, botella de agua sobre un banco cercano, algunas máquinas visibles al fondo, iluminación suave desde el techo.
Storyboard
(~2s, selfie frontal, a la distancia del brazo) Entra caminando, cámara en alto, sonrisa brillante pese a un leve jadeo. CHASE: "Okay guys, quick workout vlog today!"
(~2s, whip pan handheld) La cámara barre desde el rack de pesas → pared de espejos → zona de colchonetas, y luego vuelve a su rostro. CHASE (fuera de cámara, juguetona): "Gym's pretty quiet right now, perfect timing."
(~2s, handheld medio, junto al espejo) Revisa su forma en el espejo a mitad de un estiramiento, ajustándose la coleta. CHASE: "Just stretching before I start."
(~1.5s, inserto macro, poca profundidad de campo) Primer plano de sus manos girando la tapa de una botella de agua, con condensación en la botella. Sin diálogo — solo sonido ambiente del gimnasio.
(~2s, handheld medio, siguiéndola) Demuestra un movimiento rápido de ejercicio — una sentadilla ligera o una zancada — mirando a la cámara entre repeticiones. CHASE: "Just a few of these and I'm already feeling it."
(~2s, corte ágil, sentada en un banco) Se sienta, toma un sorbo de agua, se seca la cara con la toalla, exhalando. CHASE: "Okay, water break, definitely needed."
(~1.5s, punch-in rápido, selfie cerrado) Con las mejillas sonrojadas y el cabello ligeramente húmedo, sonríe a la lente. CHASE: "This is the sweaty part nobody shows you."
(~2s, selfie final a la distancia del brazo) Se pone de pie, con la toalla sobre el hombro, saluda cansada pero feliz y hace un pulgar arriba antes de estirar la mano para terminar la grabación. CHASE: "Alright, that's a wrap — see you guys!"

CAMÉRA :
Ressenti de footage de caméscope DV 16mm sur bande, tenu à la main. Point de vue de CHASE qui tient la caméra directement en main. Conserver les tremblements de main, un cadrage légèrement décalé, un focus pull retardé, des zooms avant/arrière maladroits, des cadrages occasionnels en self-cam où le visage est coupé, et des plans imparfaits où le sujet se perd. Chaque plan montre CHASE tenant elle-même le caméscope, en mode selfie-cam ou à la première personne. Le caméscope n’apparaît jamais à l’écran.
LOOK :
Aspect footage de caméscope DV 16mm sur bande. Qualité numérique douce, légèrement floue, léger bruit de bande, hautes lumières qui diffusent légèrement sous l’éclairage de la salle de sport, auto-exposition qui fluctue subtilement, contraste des couleurs atténué, tons de peau réalistes.
STYLE :
Ton énergique mais décontracté de gym-vlog — dynamique entre les séries, un peu essoufflé, vrais rires, mini-commentaires motivants. Tourné entièrement à main levée, cuts rapides, alternance de plans selfie et de plans miroir.
Character
CHASE — une idol coréenne @ image dans la vingtaine. Longs cheveux noirs raides attachés en queue-de-cheval haute, traits coréens élégants et adorables, peau lumineuse avec une légère brillance post-entraînement, grands yeux. Silhouette athlétique et fine. Porte un haut de sport manches longues modeste et un jogging ample ou des leggings, bras et torse entièrement couverts, baskets, une petite serviette autour du cou. Aucun bijou.
Setting
Une salle de sport en début de soirée — mur de miroirs, rack de poids, zone de tapis, bouteille d’eau sur un banc à proximité, quelques machines visibles en arrière-plan, éclairage doux au plafond.
Storyboard
(~2s, selfie de face, à bout de bras) Elle entre en marchant, caméra levée, grand sourire malgré un léger essoufflement. CHASE: "Okay guys, quick workout vlog today!"
(~2s, whip pan tenu à la main) La caméra balaie du rack de poids → mur de miroirs → zone de tapis, puis revient sur son visage. CHASE (hors champ, enjouée): "Gym's pretty quiet right now, perfect timing."
(~2s, plan moyen à main levée, près du miroir) Elle vérifie sa posture dans le miroir pendant un étirement, en ajustant sa queue-de-cheval. CHASE: "Just stretching before I start."
(~1.5s, insert macro, faible profondeur de champ) Gros plan sur ses mains qui referment le bouchon d’une bouteille d’eau, avec de la condensation sur la bouteille. Aucun dialogue — seulement le son ambiant de la salle.
(~2s, plan moyen à main levée, la suivant) Elle montre un mouvement d’exercice rapide — un squat léger ou une fente — en jetant un coup d’œil à la caméra entre les répétitions. CHASE: "Just a few of these and I'm already feeling it."
(~2s, cut vif, assise sur un banc) Elle s’assoit, prend une gorgée d’eau, s’essuie le visage avec la serviette, en expirant. CHASE: "Okay, water break, definitely needed."
(~1.5s, punch-in rapide, selfie serré) Les joues rosies, les cheveux légèrement humides, elle sourit à l’objectif. CHASE: "This is the sweaty part nobody shows you."
(~2s, selfie final à bout de bras) Elle se lève, serviette sur l’épaule, fait un signe de la main fatigué mais heureux et un pouce levé avant de tendre la main pour arrêter l’enregistrement. CHASE: "Alright, that's a wrap — see you guys!"

ja.content:
CAMERA:
DV 16mmテープのビデオカメラで撮ったような手持ち映像の質感。CHASEがカメラを直接手に持っている一人称視点。手ブレ、フレーミングのズレ、遅れて合うフォーカス、ぎこちないズームイン／アウト、顔が途中で切れるセルフィー構図、被写体を見失う不完全なショットを維持すること。すべてのショットでCHASE自身がビデオカメラを持ち、セルフィーcamまたは一人称スタイルで撮影している。ビデオカメラ本体は画面に映らない。

LOOK:
DV 16mmテープのビデオカメラ映像の見た目。柔らかく、ややぼやけたデジタルテープの質感、かすかなテープノイズ、ジムの照明で少しだけにじむハイライト、わずかにちらつくオート露出、抑えめの色コントラスト、自然な肌色。

STYLE:
エネルギッシュだけど気取らないジムVlogのトーン — セットの合間は明るく、少し息が上がっていて、自然な笑い声、短いモチベーション系のコメント。全編手持ち、テンポの速いカット、セルフィーショットと鏡越しショットを交互に。

Character
CHASE — 20代の韓国アイドル @ image。長いストレートの黒髪を高いポニーテールにまとめ、上品でありながら愛らしい韓国的な顔立ち、運動後の軽いツヤを帯びた輝く肌、大きな目。細身でアスレチックな体型。控えめな長袖のアスレチックトップと、ゆったりしたジョガーパンツまたはレギンスを着用し、腕と胴体は完全に覆われている。スニーカー、小さなタオルを首にかけている。アクセサリーなし。

Setting
夕方早めのジム — 鏡張りの壁、ウェイトラック、マットエリア、近くのベンチに置かれた水ボトル、背景にいくつかのマシンが見える、柔らかい天井照明。

Storyboard
(~2s, front-facing selfie, arm's length) 彼女が入ってきて、少し息を切らしながらも明るい笑顔でカメラを上げる。CHASE: "Okay guys, quick workout vlog today!"
(~2s, handheld whip pan) カメラがウェイトラック → 鏡張りの壁 → マットエリアへと素早く振られ、その後彼女の顔に戻る。CHASE (off-screen, playful): "Gym's pretty quiet right now, perfect timing."
(~2s, medium handheld, by the mirror) 彼女はストレッチの途中で鏡に映るフォームを確認し、ポニーテールを整える。CHASE: "Just stretching before I start."
(~1.5s, macro insert, shallow DOF) 水ボトルのキャップを両手で回す手元のクローズアップ。ボトルには結露がついている。セリフなし — 環境音のみ。
(~2s, medium handheld, tracking her) 彼女が軽いスクワットかランジのような短いエクササイズを見せ、レップの合間にカメラへ視線を送る。CHASE: "Just a few of these and I'm already feeling it."
(~2s, snappy cut, sitting on a bench) 彼女がベンチに座り、水をひと口飲み、タオルで顔を拭いて息を吐く。CHASE: "Okay, water break, definitely needed."
(~1.5s, quick punch-in, tight selfie) 頬が赤くなり、髪が少し湿った状態で、レンズに向かってにっこり笑う。CHASE: "This is the sweaty part nobody shows you."

ko.content:
CAMERA:
DV 16mm 테이프 캠코더로 촬영한 핸드헬드 영상 느낌. CHASE가 카메라를 직접 손에 들고 있는 시점. 손떨림, 어긋난 구도, 늦게 잡히는 포커스, 어설픈 줌 인/아웃, 얼굴이 잘리는 셀프캠 구도, 피사체를 놓치는 불완전한 샷을 유지한다. 모든 샷은 CHASE가 직접 캠코더를 들고 셀피캠 또는 1인칭 스타일로 촬영한 것이다. 캠코더 자체는 화면에 절대 등장하지 않는다.
LOOK:
DV 16mm 테이프 캠코더 영상 같은 룩. 부드럽고 약간 흐릿한 디지털 테이프 화질, 희미한 테이프 노이즈, 체육관 조명 아래에서 살짝 번지는 하이라이트, 미세하게 깜빡이는 자동 노출, 절제된 색 대비, 자연스러운 피부 톤.
STYLE:
에너지 넘치지만 편안한 gym-vlog 톤 — 세트 사이에는 활기차고, 약간 숨이 차 있으며, 자연스러운 웃음과 짧은 동기부여 코멘터리. 전반적으로 핸드헬드, 빠른 컷 전환, 셀피샷과 거울샷을 번갈아 사용.
Character
CHASE — 20대의 한국 아이돌 @ image. 긴 생머리를 높은 포니테일로 묶었고, 우아하면서도 사랑스러운 한국적 이목구비, 운동 후의 은은한 윤기가 도는 피부, 큰 눈. 슬림한 운동 체형. 단정한 긴소매 운동 상의와 루즈핏 조거 팬츠 또는 레깅스를 착용하고, 팔과 상체는 완전히 가려져 있으며, 스니커즈와 목에 걸친 작은 수건을 착용. 액세서리는 없음.
Setting
초저녁의 체육관 — 거울 벽, 웨이트 랙, 매트 구역, 근처 벤치 위의 물병, 배경에 보이는 몇 대의 운동 기구, 부드러운 천장 조명.
Storyboard
(~2s, 정면 셀피, 팔 길이) 그녀가 들어오며 카메라를 들어 올린다. 약간 숨이 차 있지만 밝게 웃는다. CHASE: "Okay guys, quick workout vlog today!"
(~2s, 핸드헬드 휩 팬) 카메라가 웨이트 랙 → 거울 벽 → 매트 구역으로 훑은 뒤 다시 그녀의 얼굴로 돌아온다. CHASE (화면 밖, 장난스럽게): "Gym's pretty quiet right now, perfect timing."
(~2s, 미디엄 핸드헬드, 거울 옆) 그녀가 스트레칭 중 거울로 자세를 확인하며 포니테일을 정리한다. CHASE: "Just stretching before I start."
(~1.5s, 매크로 인서트, 얕은 심도) 물병 뚜껑을 감싸 쥔 그녀의 손 클로즈업, 병 표면에는 물방울이 맺혀 있다. 대사 없음 — 주변 체육관 소리만.
(~2s, 미디엄 핸드헬드, 그녀를 따라가며) 가벼운 스쿼트나 런지 같은 짧은 운동 동작을 보여주고, 반복 사이사이 카메라를 힐끗 본다. CHASE: "Just a few of these and I'm already feeling it."
(~2s, 재빠른 컷, 벤치에 앉아) 그녀가 앉아 물을 한 모금 마시고, 수건으로 얼굴을 닦으며 숨을 내쉰다. CHASE: "Okay, water break, definitely needed."
(~1.5s, 빠른 펀치인, 타이트 셀피) 볼은 붉게 달아오르고 머리는 약간 젖어 있으며, 그녀가 렌즈를 향해 미소 짓는다. CHASE: "This is the sweaty part nobody shows you."
(~2s, 팔 길이 셀피 마무리) 그녀가 일어서서 수건을 어깨에 걸치고, 지친 듯하지만 행복한 손인사와 엄지척을 한 뒤 녹화를 끝내려 손을 뻗는다. CHASE: "Alright, that's a wrap — see you guys!"

zh.content:

DV 16mm 磁带摄像机手持拍摄质感。CHAS E 直接手持相机的第一视角。保持手部抖动、构图偏移、对焦延迟、笨拙的变焦拉近/拉远、偶尔出现自拍构图时脸被切掉，以及失焦丢掉主体的瑕疵镜头。每个镜头都是 CHASE 自己拿着摄像机拍摄，以自拍或第一人称风格呈现。摄像机本身绝不出现在画面中。
